verdict.rationale: Identity-verification products can plausibly offer configurable workflows with versioning, so this axis applies. The evidence shows reusable verification flows (saved configurations), manual review tools for individual verifications, and platform-level dated API versioning. None of these provide versioning, change review, or rollback of a user's own automations or flow configurations. API versioning governs Stripe's endpoints, not user automations, and the 'review tools' cover fraud review of sessions, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
